subject: CloudMart marketplace addendum - compliance evidence & next steps
messages:
From: Samira Ali <samira@cloudmart.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@cloudmart.com>, legal@cloudmart.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudMart marketplace addendum - redlines attached

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the call earlier — attaching our suggested redline set for the Redwood marketplace addendum. The key items we changed are:
- Clarified reseller fee waterfall and reporting cadence (Section 2).
- Added language carving out our marketplace escrow requirement for certain government customers (Section 5).
- Tightened audit evidence scope to require invoice-level trace only (new Exhibit B).
- Adjusted indemnity to reflect intermediary billing (minor language).

For planning, legal is requesting a list of the operational evidence you can provide (SOWs, invoicing trails, SOC2 scope) and an estimated timeline for signed execution.

Attachments: CloudMart_Marketplace_Addendum_v3_redlines.pdf (pdf, 184KB); SOW_evidence_list.xlsx (xlsx, 23KB)

Happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

—Samira
Samira Ali
Head of Partnerships, CloudMart
samira@cloudmart.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood-inference.com>
To: ben_carter <ben@redwood-inference.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood-inference.com>, Samira Ali <samira@cloudmart.com>, CloudMart Legal <legal@cloudmart.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudMart marketplace addendum - redlines attached

Ben / Laura — looping you in. See CloudMart's v3 redlines attached (they've tightened audit/evidence language and added an escrow carve). Quick asks: 

1) Ben: can Partner Ops confirm whether we can produce invoice-level trace for reseller transactions for the past 24 months? If not, what gap exists and how long to remediate?
2) Laura: does the escrow carve impact how we recognize revenue / billing flow for marketplace resales? If we need a backstop, what's the preferred Ops/legal approach?
3) Marissa: legal question — their Exhibit B narrows audit to invoice-level trace. Is that acceptable from a risk & indemnity perspective, or do we need to push back to include sample-level logs?

Proposed next steps: Ben to confirm evidence availability by EOD Thu; Laura to flag billing impact by Fri morning; I will prepare a short internal risk memo for Marissa to review and send to CloudMart legal. If we can provide the SOW evidence spreadsheet they asked for, that should help move them to a signature timeline.

Attachments referenced: CloudMart_Marketplace_Addendum_v3_redlines.pdf; SOW_evidence_list.xlsx

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Channel Partnerships | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood-inference.com

From: ben_carter <ben@redwood-inference.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood-inference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood-inference.com>, Samira Ali <samira@cloudmart.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudMart marketplace addendum - redlines attached

Karthik — thanks. Quick operational read:

- Invoice trace: we can provide invoice-level export (order id, buyer org, reseller id, invoice amount, date) for the last 24 months from our billing system. We do not currently retain per-token token-level billing in a customer-facing format that ties back to Marketplace Order IDs without a short mapping job. Estimated timeline for the mapping job: 4–6 weeks if legal requires it.
- Escrow: the carve they propose will require a clause in the Order Form to route funds for a subset of customers; Ops can support if Legal confirms carve criteria (list of customer types / NAICS codes / GSA schedules). Implementation timeline: config change + accounting mapping = ~3 weeks.
- Evidence handoff: I've attached a draft SOW_evidence_list.xlsx filled with what we can supply today and notes where we need engineering help.

Next steps (ops):
- I'll update the spreadsheet with sample export by EOD Thursday and send a secure Share link.
- If legal needs deeper logs, we should scope the mapping effort and set expectations with CloudMart.

Ben Carter
Sr. Partner Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
[attachment: SOW_evidence_list.xlsx (draft, 23KB)]

From: CloudMart Legal <legal@cloudmart.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood-inference.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood-inference.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Samira Ali <samira@cloudmart.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudMart marketplace addendum - redlines attached

Karthik / Ben / Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the draft evidence sheet. Two items from legal: 

1) Audit scope — agreeing to invoice-level trace is fine for our internal procurement controls, provided Redwood confirms retention (minimum 24 months) and can produce exports within 5 business days of request. Please confirm these SLAs.
2) Escrow carve — we will provide a short list of customer types that trigger the escrow requirement (will share by tomorrow). For execution speed, once Redwood confirms the evidence SLA above we'll prepare a packet for signature. We plan to send a DocuSign in parallel so commercial can close prior to our final redline pass, but signature will be contingent on your confirmation on evidence retention.

DocuSign link (preview): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123-cloudmart-addendum

If you can acknowledge the 24-month retention and the 5-business-day export SLA, we can target signature the week of Jun 21.

Regards,

Tom Hsu
Counsel, CloudMart
legal@cloudmart.com
